scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.cy:open: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npx cypress open --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts
scripts.test-local:smoke: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@smoke
scripts.test-local:e2e: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@regression --spec 'cypress/tests/e2e/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}'
scripts.test-local:api: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@regression --spec 'cypress/tests/api/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}'
scripts.test-local:firefox: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser firefox --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@smoke
scripts.test-local:edge: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser edge --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@smoke
scripts.test-local:mobile: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@mobile
scripts.test-local:tablet: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cypress run --browser chrome --config-file local.config.ts --env grepTags=@tablet
